title: MASTERS ATTP – the expression of performance and supremacy!
body_html:
The MASTERS ATTP tournament is regarded as one of the most prestigious and eagerly awaited table tennis events in the country, bringing together the TOP-18 players in the Republic of Moldova. Held every year, it is a top-level competition that rewards players’ outstanding performances.

PRESTIGE: MASTERS ATTP brings together only the best players, and places are very limited, which gives it an extremely high level of competition. Only the best according to the ranking of the National Sports Association ATTP can take part, making it a true test of quality.

COMPETITION FORMAT: MASTERS uses a round-robin knockout format in which players face a series of intense matches that test both technical skill and mental resilience. That makes every match especially gripping, and the final matches are awaited with great interest given what is at stake.

VENUE: The TOP CUP Academy arena that hosts the event is chosen for its sports infrastructure, safety and suitability, as well as its tradition in the sport. Without question, MASTERS ATTP takes place at the best and most comfortable table tennis venue in the country.

PRIZES AND RECOGNITION: As well as prestige, MASTERS ATTP offers substantial prizes for the best players. It draws the attention of every table tennis amateur and professional, and its winners are regarded as true leaders of national table tennis.

SIGNIFICANCE: The MASTERS tournament plays a significant role in the national hierarchy of sporting events, with a major impact on the official ATTP ranking and on the association’s place in the domestic sporting world, while being an elite event that pits the country’s most talented and dedicated players against each other.

In short, MASTERS ATTP is a symbol of excellence and an event that fans of the sport look forward to every year.
